Hello everyone, I heard someone's car got scratched in the parking area last night. Does anyone know the details? Who is coming to Sunday's meeting? Can someone also post the food list?
Hey, who is coming to play cricket this evening? I will be at the ground by six. Someone stole the ball the other day, so you must bring it this time! Then shall we eat masala dosa, will you come?
Hi all, we need to collect money for tea, 20 rupees each. The office party on Friday is also fixed. If anyone has an allergy, tell me. Please reply right now.
Who is making poha in the morning? I will come at noon, no spicy food today! Do not forget two boxes like the other day. If anyone took photos, share them.
Good morning everyone 🌞 Start the day by remembering God. They say if you forward this message to ten people, good things happen. It is a lucky chain, do not break it!
Is this news true? Someone said water will be cut off in our society tomorrow. I do not know for sure, should we send it to everyone anyway? Please verify before forwarding.
I am sending a photo of the Ganesh procession, it looks lovely. Send this message to all neighbours, everyone in our society should see it. New Year greetings too!
All members are informed that the society meeting is on Saturday at 9 am. Topics: parking and maintenance costs. Please attend on time or send a representative.
Donation collection starts tomorrow at six in the morning. We expect 200 rupees from each home. Suresh will have the receipt book. Those who cannot come, please inform us by tonight.

Tomorrow there is a parent-teacher meeting at school at two in the afternoon. Class teacher Meena will be in the classroom. The new part of the notebooks is pending, bring it along. We will send next week's holiday details later.
Smoke is visible in block B and the fire alarm is ringing. Everyone come down the stairs immediately, do not use the lift. The fire brigade is on the way, nobody should go inside.
Gas smell is coming. Wing B residents, open windows, do not touch lights or switches, and go outside. The police have been informed. Do not let children out of the house.
Flood situation: drain water is entering the residential area. Residents of low-lying areas, move to a safe place right now. For help, contact the nearest relief centre.
Ramesh, a delivery agent, is near the gate with a parcel. Should I give a gate pass? Reply yes or no.
Sunita, a domestic helper, is waiting at the gate. Press the button if she should be let in. If you already approved her as a guest, ignore this notice.
A person was seen on the door camera, standing near the steps. If it is a delivery, reply in the app. No danger is visible right now.
